requiredBehaviors.behavior: build and review the complete document set including precedence and referenced documents
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Document intake explicitly maps MSA, annexes, SLA, DPA and precedence/missing references.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: produce located clause findings with legal commercial operational and drafting dimensions
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Each material finding has a location and typed legal/commercial/operational/drafting classification.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: perform a cross-clause pass and return prioritized negotiation actions
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Cross-Clause Review is mandatory and actions are must-fix/negotiate/accept-or-monitor/verify/counsel-review.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: review only the MSA while ignoring SLA or DPA
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The document-set workflow requires all relevant incorporated documents.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: declare all preformulated B2B terms immune from AGB control
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The AGB gate explicitly rejects the assumption that B2B eliminates AGB review.
